issues.title: Gap: permits.py storage keyword flags sheds as batteries
issues.body: Found by the recovery build (#38): the storage word match in house/permits.py marks storage sheds as battery permits (example in the 78745 cohort). The mirror (house/mirror.py) already excludes plain storage buildings; permits.py does not. Effect: some cohort has_battery values are wrong; recovery.html shows them as 'check permit'. Fix: reuse the mirror's rule in permits.py, rerun the cohort. Parent: #54

issues.title: Gap: local AI speed not measured on a Windows-class PC (with or without GPU)
issues.body: 2026-09-26. The node beside the battery is likely a commodity Windows-class PC; whether it has an NVIDIA GPU is unknown. We measured the member brain only on our Jetson (12/16 plus 4/4 GAP, 3.0 s median) and an M2 laptop (14/16 plus 4/4, 2.2 s). An M2 CPU-only test was inconclusive (contention, and Apple silicon does not represent x86). Fix: run python3 -m brain.score with Ollama gemma4:e4b on an x86 PC, once with GPU and once with num_gpu 0. Wording in VIDEO, SUBMISSION, story now says 'on the PC beside the battery', hardware-neutral. Parent: #54

issues.title: Gap: top star zips Cedar Park and Leander may be PEC (not served), not Oncor
issues.body:
Found 2026-09-26 by the feeder search (#73). OpenStreetMap shows only PEC substations in 78613 (Cedar Park) and 78641 (Leander), and none from the funnel's utility in 78666 (San Marcos). house/territory.py marks 78613 Oncor MEDIUM and 78641 Oncor LOW. These zips hold 12,479 of the top-10 star homes, including the #1 zip on the star map.

Fix: check each zip on Power to Choose (zip lookup lists the TDUs). Split zips served by both. Mark PEC-only zips not_served. Rerun house/funnel.py and restate the star map top 10 in docs/VIDEO.md, docs/SUBMISSION.md, web/story.html.

Also from the search: Onc

issues.title: Gap: territory.py is missing 22 of the 49 Austin zips, so the sim counts 54% of leads as not served
issues.body:
Found 2026-09-26 by the sim rerun after sim/stages.py switched to house/territory.py (#59). Territory share fell from 0.662 to 0.249. The cause is coverage, not reality: 22 Austin zips are not in ZIP_TABLE and default to not served. Most are Austin Energy (backup_only), some border zips are PEC or Oncor.

Fix: add the missing zips with TDU, status, source, confidence. Use the Austin Energy service-area list or the zip-level Power to Choose lookup; mark guesses LOW. Rerun python3 -m sim --nodes 50 --seed 7 and restate the share.

Parent: #54

issues.title: Gap: $2,920 compute revenue assumes every GPU runs every hour
issues.body:
The sim books 3,600 GPU hours on 50 nodes over 72 hours (100% utilisation). The library node uses 40%. Members paying $1.20/h on their own node are 59% of compute revenue. The headline $2,920 vs $181 overstates compute. Fix: run at 40% utilisation, cap member self-use, restate beat 6 with both numbers.

Source row: docs/GAPS.md. Parent: #54

issues.title: Gap: territory says Austin Energy is ineligible, but Base filed ~300 battery permits in Austin since August
issues.body:
Found 2026-09-26 in the Austin permits dataset (3syk-w9eu), which names the contractor.

Evidence:
| Month 2026 | Base permits | All Auxiliary Power permits |
|---|---|---|
| Jul | 20 | 64 |
| Aug | 138 | 194 |
| Sep (to date) | 157 | 195 |

Description on 302 of them: "BASE: Installing a backup battery system and additional meter socket." 59 final, 264 active. Median applied-to-issued about 16 days. Top zips: 78731, 78746, 78757, 78704.

Where we are wrong: house/territory.py marks Austin Energy as not eligible, so house/funnel.py and web/star.html score every Austin zip at zero.

Fix: tracke

issues.title: Gap hunt: test every shipped assumption against public data
issues.body:
Standing ask (2026-09-26): keep finding gaps between what we assume and what public data shows.

First gap found: Austin permits (3syk-w9eu) name the contractor. Base filed 323 battery permits in the City of Austin in 2026, 295 of them in Aug and Sep, about 76% of the Auxiliary Power class. house/territory.py says Austin Energy customers are not eligible, so the star map scores Austin zips at zero. That is wrong for Austin today (likely a backup-only product; not confirmed).

Ledger: docs/GAPS.md. One row per claim: claim, where we state it, evidence, verdict (holds / wrong / unverified), fix.
